portInfo.description: Dominica Air and Sea Ports Authority documents a dedicated Roseau Cruise Ship Berth in the capital, giving an explicit WGS-compatible latitude/longitude, platform dimensions (160 ft / 49 m by 37 ft / 11.30 m), an 88 m access walkway, 13 m depth alongside, five berthing dolphins and six mooring dolphins. DASPA states the berth is within walking distance of Roseau’s business and shopping areas and close to the Tourism Information Centre, Dominica Museum and Craft Center. Inland waterfalls and national-park roads need coaches timed to all-aboard — those minutes are not on the berth page.
portInfo.currency: East Caribbean Dollar (XCD), US Dollar accepted

gettingThere.distanceToCity: DASPA places the berth within walking distance of central Roseau. Inland waterfalls need a booked coach timed to all-aboard.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: DASPA places the berth within walking distance of central Roseau. Inland waterfalls need a booked coach timed to all-aboard.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Rainforest or waterfall tours by coach
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Platform is only 49 m — large ships may use dolphins/breast lines; follow crew directions.
